# OutputFlags { #imcombiners.OutputFlags }

```python
OutputFlags()
```

Per-output rejection status flags.

These bits apply to spatial-shaped `output_flags` arrays, not to the
stack-shaped `sample_flags` diagnostic arrays.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [GROW](#imcombiners.OutputFlags.GROW) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
| [MAXITERS](#imcombiners.OutputFlags.MAXITERS) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
| [MAXREJ](#imcombiners.OutputFlags.MAXREJ) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
| [NKEEP](#imcombiners.OutputFlags.NKEEP) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
| [PREMASKED](#imcombiners.OutputFlags.PREMASKED) | Per-output rejection status flags. |
